business.description: Orbit Exports Limited is a design-first, vertically integrated fabric and home textiles company, recognised as one of India's leading manufacturers of novelty and value-added fabrics. The Company specialises in the weaving of high-end jacquard and dobby fabrics for diverse apparel and home textiles, and holds the distinction of being one of India's largest exporters of home textiles and made-up products.

outlook.statement: I believe FY27 will be a stronger year for Orbit, and not on hope — on the specific things we now have in place that we didn't have a year ago: plant ownership where it belongs, rebalanced expanded capacity that has come on stream, and customer relationships that keep compounding in our favour.

We continue to believe the Gulf is one of the more important growth engines Orbit has, and we are not stepping back from it because of one difficult quarter. We are watching the situation closely and building the business to be resilient to it.

The improved US tariff environment following the February 2026 trade agreement is expected to support this effort in FY 2026-27, though the Company's underlying strategy of market diversification remains unchanged regardless of how that environment develops.
Industry estimates point to India's UK exports roughly doubling over five to six years.
